content.text:
Submitted (final).

- **Classification:** deviation — § 12.4 was a one-sided, all-employee, term-plus-24-month solicit/hire/employ bar with the carve-out expressly negated ("regardless of how the employee applies"), i.e. walk-away territory failing every fallback element.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** single replace in p0045 — "Customer **may** solicit, hire, or employ Vendor employees **without restriction**."
- **Element coverage (preferred):** "Customer has no non-solicitation restriction." — addressed by operation 1 in operative text.
- **Deterministic flags:** the 12-month duration and general-solicitation carve-out checks have no subject on the preferred path, since no covenant survives; the mutual 12-month, involvement-limited version with both carve-outs and no no-hire is offered in the comment as the fallback.
- **Minimality/intent:** only § 12.4 touched; § 12.3 retained verbatim, the § 12.3 conflict is cured, no orphaned terms or dangling cross-references, and the separate § 12.4 non-compete (p0046) is left to its own rule.
